yh19hw_tri3.notes: Rotor order is the annotator's choice (no motor numbering in the report); nose direction not stated. The three mics went through three separate USB sound cards, so channels are not guaranteed sample-synchronous (Maverick.yaml: 100-2000 Hz envelope xcorr peak within ~1 ms in recording 4). Maverick__4: motors at constant speed, drone stationary (presumably on the floor, not stated); comb ~37/75 Hz.

open_questions: Channel order (wav channel i = mic i+1) assumed; the mic-1/mic-2 swap only mirrors x, which leaves the near-symmetric rotor set unchanged within its uncertainty.
Rotor z is a guess (+-0.02 m); the drone's nose and motor numbering are undocumented.
Recording 4's support (floor vs stand) is not stated; a floor would add a strong image source ~2 x mount height away.
